title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Comforting Breakfast〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, our practice schedule for the duration of the training camp is all set.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All that remains is how we're going to handle our streams.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, since we're mainly going to be appearing on this program's official stream for a good while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'd like to stay in touch with our fans by continuing to do streams on our own channel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, what should our first stream be about?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, why don't we talk about our goals surrounding this grand prix? I know there are some things I could say now that it's underway.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's a great idea!
There's so much I wanna talk about!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If that's going to be our theme, then we'll want to stream... Some open space within this facility.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll want to give them a taste of the atmosphere, what this facility has to offer and the feel of the grand prix in general.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But things could get loud if we choose somewhere a lot of the other idols frequent, so we should try to find a spot more conducive to conversation.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... So, where would be good...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... If that's what we want, then I think I know just the place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just the place?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It's a small space for taking breaks, and there's usually not a lot of people around. It should be perfect.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, how'd you find that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While I was taking a walk around the training camp.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, a walk? By yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You wandered off on your own again...?
This place is huge. Did you get lost at all?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I was fine. I managed to get back safely, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know.
Why don't we go take a look at the place I just mentioned right now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, actually seeing it should help us get a better idea of how things will go. However...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means you have to guide us there, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you sure you can get us there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I remember the path I took, so we should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, lead the way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you do sound pretty confident.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I am. So, please follow me.
Corridor
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm fairly certain that it was this way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um, Shizuku?
I feel like we've been going in circles for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, this is our third time passing by this place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I had a feeling this would happen...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's strange...
It should be here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys, look at the monitor...
I think we're being streamed right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. People are also posting comments.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What are you girls doing?>
<You've been walking around this area for a while now.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's actually somewhere we want to go, but I seem to have forgotten how to get there.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Attention. We have a group of lost girls.>
<Where do you want to go?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... It was at the end of the corridor and there was a sofa... Oh, as well as a large flower vase.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Are you talking about the place you found during your walk the other day?>
<Pretty sure that's way in the other direction!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it is? The other direction is... This way?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<No, the other way!>
<Take a right at that corner!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This feels like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Satnav...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Turn right, go up the stairs and continue straight ahead, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate you all helping again like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, again?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now I see...
That solves the mystery of how you didn't get lost during your last walk.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They collectively acted as your navigator.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. They're all here to help her, so she should be fine even if she gets lost again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. This might actually be the perfect place for Shizuku since she has all these navigators at her disposal.
